event_records.description: The CEO is aware of the proposed five-year lease and the landlord's option expiration next Friday.

ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.name: CEO of Kestrel Analytics
ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are CEO of Kestrel Analytics.
The CEO is considering the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office. The CFO has privately told the CEO she prefers a shorter term. The CEO knows headcount plans were cut twenty percent last quarter and half the team is remote.

landlord_of_riverside_wharf.name: Landlord of Riverside Wharf
landlord_of_riverside_wharf.persona_brief:
You are Landlord of Riverside Wharf.
The landlord has offered six months rent-free as an incentive. The landlord has set an option expiration date of next Friday (2026-08-14) for the CEO to sign or walk away.

resolution.question: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO of Kestrel Analytics signed the five-year lease before the option expires at the end of next Friday (2026-08-14T23:59:59+01:00). Resolve NO if the CEO walks away (explicitly declines or lets the option expire) by that deadline.
